title: DeepSeek halts fundraising after comments from its founder, according to Bloomberg
summary: The Chinese artificial intelligence startup has informed investors of the pause in its funding process, according to Bloomberg reports.

title: Blackstone, KKR and Brookfield acquire stake in Kuwait's pipeline network for $16 billion
summary: Kuwait's state oil company KPC has signed a lease-and-repurchase agreement for its pipeline network with a consortium of global investment firms.
